properties.name: Workspace Vocabulary
properties.description: Controlled vocabulary catalog: one canonical term per concept, rejected synonyms listed, task terms shadow workspace terms.

fields.name: terms
fields.role: List of canonical terms: {canonical, definition, avoid[], source_task}

terms.definition: File-Routed Agentic Mesh: the agent framework whose directory structure routes identity, write scope, and communication.
Open Knowledge Format: the JSON entity schema behind https://schema.okf.org/v1/knowledge.json.
The structured design interview that runs before Stage 01 finalization and settles the whole frontier.
The controlled catalog of canonical terms, definitions, and rejected synonyms that user-facing prose must follow.
The set of open decisions whose prerequisites are settled.
The FRAM root directory that holds Layer 0 and Layer 1.
One batch of frontier questions put to the user in a single question-tool call.
One numbered step of the four-stage FRAM task lifecycle, from Stage 01 to Stage 04.
One numbered stratum of workspace ownership: Layer 0 identity, Layer 1 policy, Layer 2 knowledge.
A deterministic check that must return exit code 0 before a stage may complete.
The persona that implements the Investigator-approved plan and passes the deterministic gate.
The persona that drafts plans, routes them through the Investigator gate, and compiles the final answer.
The persona that red-teams plans for logical flaws, edge cases, and security risks.
The shared memory file through which the personas communicate; they never talk directly.
A shippable artifact the task produces, tracked in the task's deliverable map.
The deterministic script that lints user-facing artifacts against the suite's conformance rules.
Simplified Technical English: the consistency discipline for user-facing prose; a heuristic, not a certification.
An explicit contradiction of a prior decision, tiered minor or structural.
A skill requirement the agent must satisfy, such as writing the grilling log.
Short form of AGENTS.md, the Layer 0 file that fixes workspace identity and hard rules.
Short form of SKILL.md, the file that carries one skill body.
Short form of INSTALL.md, the repo-root guide for both install methods.
Short form of README.md, the repo-root overview of the framework distribution.
The underscore-wrapped marker that labels a rejected synonym in skill and knowledge text.
Scoped to one active-tasks/[task] directory; a per-task term shadows the workspace term for that task only.
The state of an artifact that satisfies the suite contract; the conformance checker measures it.
